review: Fresh independent publisher FAQ and core procedure saturation challenge 02
scope: Law of Root October 13, 2025; common rules, four base factions, Fall/Winter, base Vagabond characters, dominance and coalitions; exclude expansion content, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup. Applicable official publisher English p16 base-game FAQs, retrieved November 5, 2026.

independence.provenance_note: Requested settings supplied by dispatch. Runtime metadata not independently opened because input allowlist excludes it.

conclusion: No qualifying new rule, outcome branch, or consequential timing/priority/exception interaction remains in the stated core/FAQ scope. Current question requests and current key cover the relevant procedures. Confirm passes 27 and 28 as zero-addition stopping passes under working saturation, not exhaustive enumeration.

source_integrity.publisher_text_limitation: Item icons are blank in publisher extracted text; original extracted Law and matching PDF retain the item glyph letters and supplies/characters. No source claim depends on guessing missing publisher icons.

complete_read_record.read_method: Complete relevant source, full questions and key, full permitted ledger, and every FAQ occurrence read in bounded outputs. No prior evidence file cited by ledger/corrections was opened.

declared_key_corrections_independently_c.finding: Already-activated dominance partner cannot be chosen; later ordinary partner activation remains legal.
Forced Allied Alliance movement does not trigger own Outrage; other moving Allied faction pays its Outrage.
